minor.issue: Tracked-user bridged users row is created with `parent_client_id` only, but /me/features (server.py L2655) and /me/contacts scope (L7282) read `user.get('client_id') or user['id']` — which falls back to the bridged user's own id, returning DEFAULT features instead of inheriting from the parent client. Workaround in test: also $set client_id on the bridged user. Real fix: change L2655 + L7282 (and similar lines) to `user.get('client_id') or user.get('parent_client_id') or user['id']`. NOT introduced by this iteration but uncovered while testing wa_sound_alerts inheritance.

WhatsApp webhook auto-fill (L8644-8656): existing_name guard correctly checks (a) blank string OR (b) only digits/+/spaces/parens/dots/dashes via re.fullmatch — robust against phone-only names. wa_profile_name always updated; main `name` only when blank/phone-only. ✓

ClientFeaturesUpdate (L2552-2564): both anon_company and wa_sound_alerts present as Optional[bool]. _normalize_features clamps unknown → defaults. ✓

BUG (pre-existing, pattern-wide): server.py L2655 `parent_id = user.get('client_id') or user['id']` does NOT fall back to `parent_client_id`. The bridged users row created by /admin/tracked-users/{id}/set-password (L4644-4659) only sets `parent_client_id`, never `client_id` — so /me/features for tracked users returns defaults (admin's flags ignored). Same issue at L7282 (me_list_contacts scope). Inconsistent with L2234/L2247/L2268 which DO use parent_client_id. Recommend a single helper `_resolve_client_scope(user)` that returns `user.get('client_id') or user.get('parent_client_id') or user['id']` and use it everywhere.
FEATURE_META in AdminClientFeatures.jsx (L65/L101): both new entries present; data-testids `features-toggle-anon_company` + `features-toggle-wa_sound_alerts` rendered. ✓

Contacts.jsx (L357): contact-unique-code-{id} badge with lock icon under the name. ContactEditModal photo gating uses canManagePhoto (admin/superviseur/moderateur) — verified disabled=False for admin role. ✓
